spec_text_or_path: Minions raised as copies of WORLD/MAP monsters: the summoner's minion pool is the game's enemy roster, and each raised minion INHERITS the captured monster's native ability kit (dossier: 'Raise permanent copy of map monster; spectre fights independently' + 'Spectres retain all their monster abilities'). Engine proxies are kit-generated content with kit-declared skills; there is no capture-from-world acquisition lane and no monster-ability-inheritance lane. Companion questions if minted: corpse-fuel acquisition ritual (Desecrate) and per-era pool identity (Solar Guards / Slave Drivers / Syndicate Operatives) as selectable minion loadouts.
